Stages.Description: Learn the line: tap a Swordsman to send it out of the caravan, then an Archer to follow it. Break the gate and rout every wave to win.
Fast ghouls join the road. Send a Shield Knight out first to protect your Archers.
Runners slip between the lamp posts. Keep a defender ahead of your archers.
Brutes hold the front while Blight Casters fire from behind. Keep a defender in front of your ranged troops.
Brutes shoulder through the toll gate behind walker screens. Hold courage for the second push.
Fast dead and curse fire return to the King's Road. Keep archers behind a solid front line.
Spitters lob blight from the steps. Close the distance with melee before they settle.
A grave procession takes the King's Road with siege bolts and revenant officers. Keep melee and ranged troops together.

MissionEvents.Title: Militia Lantern Cart
MissionEvents.Summary: Hold the market lane while the lantern cart hauls powder and rations back to the wagon.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: the wagon is patched and militia escorts join the next push.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: the cart burns and the wagon takes a direct hit.

Stages.Description: The Grave Lord's vanguard tests the bell road. Clear each wave before the next arrives.

MissionEvents.Title: Militia Lantern Cart
MissionEvents.Summary: Hold the market lane while the lantern cart hauls powder and rations back to the wagon.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: the wagon is patched and militia escorts join the next push.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: the cart burns and the wagon takes a direct hit.

Stages.Description: First commander: the Grave Lord rallies escorts. Break the gate and defeat him; save courage for the warning at half health.
Rot Hulks burst when defeated. Spread your reinforcements and let ranged troops finish them.
Bone Nests split when destroyed. Keep courage in reserve to catch the smaller undead.
Bloaters drift in with the fog. Let ranged troops pop them before they reach your line.
Armored enemies and Dread Heralds support each other. Focus the herald, then bring down the heavy frontline.
The Tidecaller holds the harbor mouth. Its entries begin toward the end of the battle.
Splitters crowd the long sheds. Keep courage ready to catch the pieces.
Drowned hulks grind along the docks in long waves. Pace your courage.
Crushers lead the tide onto the point. Stack melee in front of the wagon.
Howlers rally the drowned for the final push. Break them early.
The chains drag up a drowned command ship while plague engines rake the dock. The Harrow Tidemaster calls the tide in last.

MissionEvents.Title: Harpoon Winch
MissionEvents.Summary: Cover the winch crew long enough to pin the command ship and tear open the dock lane.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: the chains slam home, crack the keep, and drag the tide line open.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: the command ship slips free and the harbor regains footing.

Stages.Description: Third district unlocked. Coal spurs favor split-brood screens, sapper dives, and brute-led pushes.

Molten choke points, sapper flanks, and reinforced gates reward higher gate damage and disciplined deployment.
Recommended squad: Halberdier + Shield Knight + Mage.
Saboteurs dash for the wagon between the coal carts. Keep a fast melee unit on the line.
Steady heavy pushes, split-brood screens, and sapper feints test how well the caravan recovers between surges.
Furnace vents flare across the hall. Advance between bursts.
Furnace vents, split broods and sapper dives peak together. Advance between vent bursts.
Heavy columns crawl down the slag run. Siege troops earn their keep here.
The forge cracks open: plague engines, revenant captains and furnace surges hit at once. Bring siege troops.

MissionEvents.Title: Furnace Charge
MissionEvents.Summary: Hold the crucible lane long enough for the furnace charge to rupture the molten wall.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: the blast lands, scorches the keep, and keeps the line open.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: the wall resets and the foundry line hardens again.

Stages.Description: The forge guard holds the crucible gate. Spend courage on a strong front line.

MissionEvents.Title: Furnace Charge
MissionEvents.Summary: Hold the crucible lane long enough for the furnace charge to rupture the molten wall.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: the blast lands, scorches the keep, and keeps the line open.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: the wall resets and the foundry line hardens again.

Stages.Description: The Iron Warden tests a prepared frontline. Bring level 3 troops and a Mounted Ballista; dodge furnace warnings and save courage for his escort call.
Fourth district unlocked. Warded barriers and purge bells set up blight fire behind sealed gates.
Caustic wash halls punish overcommits while curse support stacks behind the ritual lanes.
Jammers smother your signal near the pits. Win fights fast before courage dries up.
Plaguehouse barricades harden up while sappers and dread heralds try to crack the caravan from behind.
Purge cycles and sealed kill-box walls hold until the Plague Archon breaches the vault.
Shieldwalls lock the cordon. Bring troops that hit hard up close.
Hold the failing purge seal while jammers smother your signal. The Plague Archon returns at the end.

MissionEvents.Title: Purge Seal
MissionEvents.Summary: Hold the failing seal circle long enough to keep the containment grid from turning on the caravan.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: courage surge and cleaner recovery when the seal stabilizes.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: lose card tempo if the seal fails under pressure.

Stages.Description: Spitter crews fire from the ward windows. Keep moving forward.

MissionEvents.Title: Purge Seal
MissionEvents.Summary: Hold the failing seal circle long enough to keep the containment grid from turning on the caravan.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: courage surge and cleaner recovery when the seal stabilizes.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: lose card tempo if the seal fails under pressure.

Stages.Description: The vault guard musters everything left. Keep the wagon healthy for the last waves.

MissionEvents.Title: Purge Seal
MissionEvents.Summary: Hold the failing seal circle long enough to keep the containment grid from turning on the caravan.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: courage surge and cleaner recovery when the seal stabilizes.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: lose card tempo if the seal fails under pressure.

Stages.Description: The seal complex ruptures into a plague court. Signal denial and escort commanders shield the Plague Monarch.

MissionEvents.Title: Ward Seal Lattice
MissionEvents.Summary: Hold the seal lattice long enough to purge the plague signal and reopen the ward corridor.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: courage surges, cooldown recovery steadies, and the ward line locks in.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: the plague signal deepens and the wagon takes a purge hit.

Stages.Description:
Frostbound scouts test the cliff road while raiders look for the war wagon axle.
Recommended squad: Shield Knight + Archer + Siege Engineer.

Narrow turns compress the climb under sleet while howlers and sappers chain quick dives.
Recommended squad: Shield Knight + Crossbowman + Halberdier.
Tunnelers break through the snow behind your line. Keep a guard near the wagon.

Avalanche bells ring over the pass, and the crew must steady the shrine dais before the drifts crack open again.
Recommended squad: Battle Monk + Mage + Shield Knight.

MissionEvents.Title: Avalanche Shrine
MissionEvents.Summary: Hold the shrine dais long enough to silence the dead bells before the pass collapses again.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: +12 courage and cleaner deck recovery once the bells go quiet.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: lose courage and card tempo if the shrine falls.

Stages.Description: Mirrors copy your strongest troops on the bridge. Send many small units.

MissionEvents.Title: Avalanche Shrine
MissionEvents.Summary: Hold the shrine dais long enough to silence the dead bells before the pass collapses again.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: +12 courage and cleaner deck recovery once the bells go quiet.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: lose courage and card tempo if the shrine falls.

Stages.Description:
Watchfire bastions harden the lane while horns and raid ladders drive the climb.
Recommended squad: Shield Knight + Crossbowman + Battle Monk.
Avalanche lanes sweep the ridge. Time your pushes between slides.
Whiteout hides bone ballistas on the ramparts. Rush them before they wear down the wagon.

MissionEvents.Title: Warhorn Pyre
MissionEvents.Summary: Hold the pyre long enough to smother the raider horns before the pass collapses again.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: +12 courage, cleaner card recovery, and a heavier shove through the pass.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: the horns stay lit and a fast raid surge crashes into the wagon.

Stages.Description: The pass guard holds the scree. Bring siege troops for the last stretch.

MissionEvents.Title: Warhorn Pyre
MissionEvents.Summary: Hold the pyre long enough to smother the raider horns before the pass collapses again.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: +12 courage, cleaner card recovery, and a heavier shove through the pass.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: the horns stay lit and a fast raid surge crashes into the wagon.

Stages.Description: Thornwall Pass boss stage. Avalanche bells and watchfire volleys hold until the Thornwall Chieftain storms the gate.

Collapsed transepts and pew barricades turn the first nave into a slow grind under curse fire.
Recommended squad: Shield Knight + Mage + Archer.

Bone courts spill smaller dead while hexers and heralds hold the center under crumbling saints.
Recommended squad: Alchemist + Battle Monk + Shield Knight.
Liches raise the fallen behind the choir stalls. Push through to the casters.

The choir loft rains curses over the aisle while reliquary bearers try to cross the nave under caravan cover.
Recommended squad: Crossbowman + Mage + Battle Monk.

MissionEvents.Title: Reliquary Bearers
MissionEvents.Summary: Hold the aisle long enough for the reliquary bearers to reach the war wagon.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: a repair burst and escort reinforcement once the relics clear the nave.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: the war wagon takes a direct hit if the escort lane collapses.

Stages.Description: Reliquary flares and censer clouds hold until the Bone Pontiff claims the high altar.
Shieldwalls guard the vault stair. Heavy hitters first, archers behind.

Relic vault stairs narrow the line into a ceremonial kill zone guarded by elite undead and curse engines.
Recommended squad: Halberdier + Shield Knight + Mage.
Splitters crowd the narrow gallery. Keep courage ready for the pieces.
The reliquary wakes. Hold a strong line through every wave.
The vault gives way beneath the caravan as the Reliquary Tyrant rises with its embalmed giants. Save courage for the tyrant.

MissionEvents.Title: Vault Bearers
MissionEvents.Summary: Hold the cracked nave long enough for ward bearers to drag the reliquary chest back to the caravan.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: the ward chest patches the wagon and sanctified escorts reinforce the line.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: the chest is shattered and the wagon takes a direct reliquary hit.

Stages.Description:
The first plank roads sink under shambling dead and rot mist while the caravan tests the bog line.
Recommended squad: Shield Knight + Siege Engineer + Archer.

Flooded pews and bell wakes narrow the lane while curse support stacks behind the mire dead.
Recommended squad: Battle Monk + Mage + Shield Knight.
Bloaters wade out of the reeds. Pop them at range.

A chained plague ferry drags the fight into a soaked choke point full of split-brood and blight fire.
Recommended squad: Alchemist + Crossbowman + Shield Knight.
Siege towers roll up the causeway. Break them before they unload.

Deep mire drag, plague bells, and endless drift pools force a patient advance against attrition-heavy pressure.
Recommended squad: Siege Engineer + Battle Monk + Mage.
The dead rise from the drowned graves in waves. Pace your courage.
A plague flotilla drifts beside the causeway while rot hulks and drowned giants grind every step.

MissionEvents.Title: Blackwater Bell
MissionEvents.Summary: Hold the bell barge beacon long enough to break the drowned procession's rhythm.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: courage surges and the next mire push bogs down around the lane.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: the bell tolls and a plague wake slams the wagon.

Stages.Description: The mire bell calls everything left. Keep the wagon healthy.

MissionEvents.Title: Blackwater Bell
MissionEvents.Summary: Hold the bell barge beacon long enough to break the drowned procession's rhythm.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: courage surges and the next mire push bogs down around the lane.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: the bell tolls and a plague wake slams the wagon.

Stages.Description: Mire of Saints boss stage. Plague fog and chapel bells roll until the Mire Behemoth rises at the drowned altar.

Charred shelters and open lanes force quick answers to raider probes and horn-led rushes.
Recommended squad: Cavalry Rider + Archer + Shield Knight.

Open ground and cinder wind favor fast raiders, howler signals, and long flanking dives.
Recommended squad: Cavalry Rider + Crossbowman + Battle Monk.
Runners sweep across the open grass. Defenders hold them off your archers.

Roving siege tents and breach crews turn the lane into a tempo fight over repeated dives.
Recommended squad: Halberdier + Battle Monk + Cavalry Rider.
Brutes charge out of the war camp. Keep courage for a second wall.

The redoubt burns hot with horn relays and rider pressure that punish any stalled push.
Recommended squad: Cavalry Rider + Battle Monk + Crossbowman.
Crushers lead the column past the barrows. Siege troops help here.
Horns call charge after charge across the open steppe. Break each wave before the next horn sounds.

MissionEvents.Title: Horn Relay
MissionEvents.Summary: Hold the relay lane long enough for outriders to drag the signal cart back through the ash.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: the relay lands and fast escorts join the route with a short speed surge.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: the relay burns and a flank rush clips the wagon.

Stages.Description: The war band gathers on the ridge. Break each wave before the next.

MissionEvents.Title: Horn Relay
MissionEvents.Summary: Hold the relay lane long enough for outriders to drag the signal cart back through the ash.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: the relay lands and fast escorts join the route with a short speed surge.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: the relay burns and a flank rush clips the wagon.

Stages.Description: Sunfall Steppe boss stage. Fire lines and horn relays pound the lane until the Steppe Warlord charges out of the warcamp.

The timber edge closes in with ambush packs, snare hazards, and curse-lit brush.
Recommended squad: Crossbowman + Mage + Shield Knight.

The circle grounds the fight under hex support and repeated flank dives from the treeline.
Recommended squad: Mage + Battle Monk + Crossbowman.
Glowcaps hide tunnelers. Keep a guard close to the wagon.

A cursed timber road turns every stall into an ambush window for raiders and hexers.
Recommended squad: Halberdier + Mage + Shield Knight.
Saboteurs dart between the kilns. Fast melee keeps them off the wagon.

Every advance through the grove is punished by snare roots, curse fire, and hidden breach teams.
Recommended squad: Battle Monk + Crossbowman + Halberdier.
Liches chant beneath the oaks. Push through to the casters.
Tunnelers and mirror knights strike out of the fog. Keep a guard by the wagon.

MissionEvents.Title: Witchlight Knot
MissionEvents.Summary: Hold the witchlight knot long enough to expose the hidden trails and break the moonless snare.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: courage steadies, card recovery smooths out, and the lane stops slipping blind.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: the route stays blind and hidden attackers keep cutting into the convoy.

Stages.Description: The verge closes in. Hold a strong line to the end.

MissionEvents.Title: Witchlight Knot
MissionEvents.Summary: Hold the witchlight knot long enough to expose the hidden trails and break the moonless snare.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: courage steadies, card recovery smooths out, and the lane stops slipping blind.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: the route stays blind and hidden attackers keep cutting into the convoy.

Stages.Description: Gloamwood Verge boss stage. Thorn snares and witchfire close the lane until the Gloamwood Witch rises in the heart circle.

The outer bridge forts lock the lane under mixed support fire and heavy breach pressure.
Recommended squad: Shield Knight + Crossbowman + Battle Monk.

Collapsed walls and siege rubble force a grinding advance against mixed command waves.
Recommended squad: Halberdier + Siege Engineer + Mage.
Revenant captains lead the garrison. Kill them first and the rest falter.

Gatehouse towers and command relays stack pressure while the breach crew tries to crack the crownward wall.
Recommended squad: Shield Knight + Battle Monk + Crossbowman.

MissionEvents.Title: Breach Crew
MissionEvents.Summary: Keep the charge line clear long enough for the crew to break the crownward gate braces.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: direct gatehouse damage when the breach charge lands.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: the gatehouse regains footing and hull if the charge fails.

Stages.Description: Mixed command waves and breach lines hold the keep until the Dread Sovereign joins the siege.
Boneballistas cover the yard. Rush them with fast troops.
The inner ring tightens into an attrition line where heralds, hexers and raiders converge.
Shieldwalls hold the wall walk. Bring heavy hitters.
The Ashen Regent's guard musters for the last stand. Spend everything.
The throne hall erupts in mixed command waves as the Ashen Regent seizes the breach. Spend everything.

MissionEvents.Title: Throne Sappers
MissionEvents.Summary: Keep the throne-side breach lane open long enough for sappers to collapse the regent's cover wall.
MissionEvents.RewardSummary: Reward: direct keep damage lands and the breach corridor stays marked open.
MissionEvents.PenaltySummary: Risk: the throne wall recovers and elite guards reset the lane.
